name: Cytisine
aliases: sophorin, baptitoxin, baptitoxine, Baptitoxine, cytisin, laburnin, sophorine, Sophorine
summary: Cytisine, also known as baptitoxine, cytisinicline, or sophorine, is an alkaloid that occurs naturally in several plant genera, such as Laburnum and Cytisus of the family Fabaceae. It was first reported in 1865 and has been used medically to help with smoking cessation.
